title: Learning Administrative Boundary-Aware Location Encoders via Reverse Geocoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.24306v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Location encoders learn compact representations of latitude--longitude coordinates for downstream geospatial prediction tasks. Existing approaches are pretrained using continuous or naturally occurring supervision, such as imagery, climate variables, or species distributions, and therefore do not explicitly capture administrative boundaries or place names, despite their strong influence on many real-world geospatial phenomena. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first method for learning administrative boundary-aware location encoders, using reverse-geocoded text as a self-supervised training signal. Our approach can be applied to existing location encoder architectures and consistently improves their downstream performance. We further introduce RevGeoRQ, a custom architecture tailored to reverse-geocoding supervision, which yields additional gains and exceeds contemporary location encoders on several downstream tasks. translated_title: 通过逆地理编码学习行政边界感知的位置编码器
translated_abstract: 位置编码器学习经纬度坐标的紧凑表示，用于下游地理空间预测任务。现有方法使用连续的或自然产生的监督信号（如影像、气候变量或物种分布）进行预训练，因此无法显式捕捉行政边界或地名，尽管它们对许多真实世界的地理空间现象有着强烈影响。据我们所知，我们首次提出了学习行政边界感知位置编码器的方法，使用逆地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号。我们的方法可以应用于现有的位置编码器架构，并持续提升其下游性能。我们进一步提出了RevGeoRQ，一种为逆地理编码监督量身定制的架构，带来了额外的性能增益，并在多个下游任务上超越了当代的位置编码器。
tldr: 本文首次提出利用逆地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号来学习行政边界感知的位置编码器，并设计了专属架构RevGeoRQ，可提升现有编码器性能并在多个下游任务上超越当代方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first method for learning administrative boundary-aware location encoders using reverse-geocoded text as a self-supervised training signal, and proposes RevGeoRQ, a tailored architecture that improves existing encoders and outperforms contemporary location encoders on several downstream tasks.
